title: Beasts
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Sub-group of World Creatures: bears, bristleback boars, mammoths, netch, sabre cats, skeevers and wolves. Mammoths and netch: none of their factions has a relation to `PlayerFaction`; mammoths are `Aggression: Aggressive`, netch are unaggressive (no `Aggression` field) `[verified]`. The Guardian Spirits on these pages (mammoth, bear, skeever, wolf, sabre cat) are among the quarry of *Kyne’s Sacred Trials* (`dunHunterQST` 018601).
